request.style: English, male baritone solo with choir, harp, oboe, cello, timpani, warm and solemn mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Asher's line in Goshen stands
Imnah and Ishvah in the land
Ishvi walks with sister Serah
Beriah holds the father's care
Heber and Malchiel are born
Their names are carried like a horn

[Chorus]
Beriah the head of families
Clans that multiply and stay
From the plains of Moab to here
The Beriites stand without fear

[Verse]
Ephraim weeps for days of grief
His brothers lost to sudden death
He goes in to his wife alone
A son is born in sorrow's tone
He names him Beriah in pain
Because disaster marked the rain

[Chorus]
Beriah the head of families
Clans that multiply and stay
From the plains of Moab to here
The Beriites stand without fear

[Verse]
In Aijalon the leaders rise
Beriah drives out Gath's surprise
Shema stands by his side strong
Heads of families, not for long
Ahio and Shashak are named
Jeremoth is not to blame
Zebadiah and Arad follow
Eder walks through the hallow

[Chorus]
Beriah the head of families
Clans that multiply and stay
From the plains of Moab to here
The Beriites stand without fear

[Outro]
The names are written in the book
Of the sons of Asher's hook
